title: Local development deploy must fail closed without integration-test role ARN and installation name
description: Drift risk: a development control-plane deploy run from a shell without CHATTICUS_INTEGRATION_TEST_ALLOWED_ROLE_ARN and CHATTICUS_INSTALLATION_NAME set would remove the integration-test SSM parameter and the installation tag. The local deploy script should fail closed when either is unset, or resolve them itself.
right_now_summary: The local deploy script must stop unless the integration-test role ARN and installation name are set or resolved.
